caption: The drawing consists of a rectangular section filled with patterns in shades of reddish-brown and a beige background. Inside the section, there are five large equilateral triangles, evenly spaced and pointing upward, their interiors shaded with horizontal lines. Above each triangle is a circle drawn in the same reddish-brown color. The base of the triangles rests on a thick, solid horizontal band also in reddish-brown, which runs parallel to the bottom edge of the rectangular section. Below this band is another, thinner horizontal strip that forms the bottom edge of the colored area; in this section, a wavy line moves horizontally across, with small dots placed at regular intervals below each crest and trough of the wave. The composition is simple and geometric, with a clear repetitive pattern. Outside the colored rectangular section, the surrounding area is pale beige. In the bottom right corner outside the rectangular section, the name "HILDA OLSON" is written in small, uppercase letters.
title: Section of Wall Decoration-Mission San Francisco de Assis (Dolores)
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
